name: Cro-Akon
description: Cro-Akon was a world located in the Thuldin's Grant sector within the Expansion Region of the galaxy. Prior to being taken to the Deep in the Unknown Regions, a Z7 series construction droid was part of a crew that built a settlement in the tundra of Cro-Akon.
lead_paragraphs: Cro-Akon was a world located in the Thuldin's Grant sector within the Expansion Region of the galaxy. Prior to being taken to the Deep in the Unknown Regions, a Z7 series construction droid was part of a crew that built a settlement in the tundra of Cro-Akon.
